name: Protocol Buffers
description: Code assistance for Protocol Buffers files with Buf.
about: In Gode’s editor, Buf provides language support for Protocol Buffers files. Its language server starts when you open a .proto file in a project and stops when none are open. The Buf executable is included with this plugin.
